title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Experience: 3–4 Years

Location: Noida

Working Days \- 6

Employment Type: Full\-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented UI/UX Designer with 2–4 years of professional experience to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a strong eye for design, a deep understanding of UI/UX principles, and hands\-on experience designing modern, intuitive, and user\-friendly digital products using Figma.

You will work closely with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to design engaging user experiences for websites, mobile applications, dashboards, and other digital products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design clean, modern, and user\-friendly interfaces using Figma.
* Create wireframes, user flows, customer journeys, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs.
* Design responsive websites, landing pages, mobile applications, dashboards, and web applications.
* Develop and maintain reusable design systems, components, and style guides.
* Ensure consistency in typography, colors, spacing, and overall visual design.
* Collaborate closely with developers to ensure pixel\-perfect implementation.
* Conduct competitor analysis and contribute to improving user experience.
* Iterate and improve designs based on feedback, usability testing, and business requirements.
* Organize and maintain Figma files, libraries, and components.
* Stay updated with the latest UI/UX trends, tools, and best practices.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* 3–4 years of experience as a UI/UX Designer or Product Designer.
* Strong proficiency in Figma.
* Excellent understanding of UI/UX principles, responsive design, and accessibility.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and interactive user flows.
* Strong knowledge of design systems and reusable components.
* Good understanding of typography, color theory, spacing, and visual hierarchy.
* Experience collaborating with developers and cross\-functional teams.
* Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS is a plus.
* Experience with Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and FigJam is preferred.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and time management skills.

**Portfolio Requirement**

Candidates must share their portfolio along with their application.

**The portfolio should demonstrate:**

* Websites, mobile apps, dashboards, or SaaS products
* Wireframes and prototypes
* High\-fidelity UI designs
* Design systems or component libraries (preferred)

**Applications without a relevant portfolio will not be considered.**

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on exciting real\-world digital products.
* Collaborate with a talented and supportive team.
* Opportunity to learn, grow, and take ownership of design decisions.
* Exposure to end\-to\-end product design and development.

**How to Apply**

**Email: hr@rahaneaitech.com**

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in UI/UX Design?
* Which design tools are you proficient in? (Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop, Illustrator, CorelDRAW, etc.)
* Please share your portfolio link or previous design work.
* Do you have experience designing websites, web applications, or mobile applications?
* Please mention your current salary \-
* Expected salary

Work Location: In person

title: Website Designer
description:
Job Description: Website Designer \& Blog Writer

Company: Cerebellum Academy

Department: Marketing \& Content

Employment Type: Full\-time

Location: Noida

Experience: 1–3 years

About the Role

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented Website Designer with Blog Writing

expertise to manage and improve our website’s design, user experience, and content. The

ideal candidate should have a good understanding of website design, SEO\-friendly content

writing, and digital marketing.

Key Responsibilities

 Design, update, and maintain website pages, landing pages, and promotional

sections.

 Create user\-friendly, visually appealing, and mobile\-responsive website layouts.

 Write engaging, informative, and SEO\-friendly blogs related to medical education

and exam preparation.

 Conduct keyword research and optimise blogs for search engine rankings.

 Create website content, including headlines, descriptions, banners, FAQs, and course

pages.

 Improve website navigation, user experience, page speed, and overall presentation.

 Coordinate with the marketing, academic, and technical teams for website updates.

 Monitor website performance using tools such as Google Analytics and Google

Search Console.

 Regularly update existing content to improve accuracy, relevance, and SEO

performance.

 Ensure all website content follows the brand’s tone and communication style.

Required Skills and Qualifications

 Bachelor’s degree in Web Design, Digital Marketing, Mass Communication, English,

or a related field.

 1–3 years of experience in website designing and blog/content writing.

 Knowledge of HTML, CSS, WordPress, and basic website editing.

 Strong understanding of SEO, keyword research, on\-page optimisation, and content

structure.

 Excellent English writing, editing, and proofreading skills.

 Basic knowledge of graphic design tools such as Canva, Photoshop, or Figma.

 Understanding of responsive design and mobile\-friendly layouts.

 Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

 Good communication and coordination skills.

Preferred Skills

 Experience working with education, edtech, healthcare, or medical content.

 Knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO tools.

 Basic understanding of website speed optimisation and conversion\-focused landing

pages.

 Experience creating content for NEET PG, FMGE, INI\-CET, or other competitive

examinations.

What We Offer

 Opportunity to work with a leading medical education brand.

 Creative and growth\-oriented work environment.

 Opportunity to work on high\-impact website and content projects.

 Career growth and learning opportunities.

 Salary: Rs25000 – Rs 40000

Pay: ₹30,016\.88 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
